title: Dreaming in different visual mediums
content: So the mall World dreams have been pretty persistent now for quite some time. But recently, as they've become more intense, I've begun to dream in different mediums. A few weeks ago I had this dream where I was in this house but at one point I came upon this periscope. When I looked into it, I could see everything outside of the house being mapped in in this sort of grayscale lidar. But I wasn't just seeing what was in front of me, I was able to move the Periscope around and see everything being mapped in in what felt like real time. And then about a week ago, I had this dream where I was in this old-timey horse and buggy type carriage. The one with the drapes and stuff on the inside you know? When I looked outside of the window of the carriage, I was seeing everything in this old old turn of the century film reel. Everyone looked sort of blotchy and slightly blurred and jolte just like I was looking at a sepia filter late 18th century video camera or something. There was a slight color to it, as if it had been remastered. I've never experienced anything like either of these dreams before. Has anybody else experienced anything like this before or since they started dreaming of Mall World?
